knowledge:
- key_parameters: exprs.1=Normalized gene expression data under condition 1 (SummarizedExperiment, data.frame, or matrix) with rows as genes and columns as samples ;; exprs.2=Normalized gene expression data under condition 2 (SummarizedExperiment, data.frame, or matrix) with rows as genes and columns as samples. Must have the same number of genes in the same order as exprs.1 ;; r.method=Correlation method passed to WGCNA::cor (e.g., "spearman" or "pearson") ;; q.method=Multiple testing correction method passed to stats::p.adjust
- alternatives: FGNet=For downstream functional enrichment analysis of identified DCGs ;; clusterProfiler=For downstream functional enrichment analysis of identified DCGs ;; enrichr=For downstream functional enrichment analysis of identified DCGs ;; igraph=For visualizing and analyzing the differential coexpression network of DCLs ;; DCGL v2.0=For identifying upstream causal regulators from DCLs
- when_to_use: When comparing gene coexpression networks between two distinct biological conditions (e.g., treated vs. control, disease vs. healthy) to identify rewired gene interactions (DCLs) and highly rewired hub genes (DCGs).
- pitfalls: Input matrices exprs.1 and exprs.2 must have the exact same number of genes in the exact same order ;; Running the analysis on a full genome-wide dataset (e.g., ~6000 genes) can be computationally intensive, taking around 20 minutes on an 8-core, 16GB RAM machine; multi-threading should be enabled using allowWGCNAThreads() to optimize performance.

workflows.name: differential_coexpression_analysis
workflows.intent: Identify differentially coexpressed gene pairs (DCLs) and genes (DCGs) from normalized expression data under two conditions.
input: exprs.1 (normalized gene expression matrix/data.frame/SummarizedExperiment for condition 1)
exprs.2 (normalized gene expression matrix/data.frame/SummarizedExperiment for condition 2)
workflows.stages: 1. Load the package and enable multi-threading ;; 2. Run the differential coexpression analysis using diffcoexp ;; 3. Inspect the structure of the output list containing DCGs and DCLs
workflows.code:
library(diffcoexp)
data(gse4158part)
allowWGCNAThreads()
res=diffcoexp(exprs.1 = exprs.1, exprs.2 = exprs.2, r.method = "spearman" )
str(res)
